name: SpriteCook Generate Sprites
headline: GPT Image 2: Image Generation & Editing
short_description: GPT Image 2 allows users to generate and edit images from text or references using the Pilio CLI. Ideal for developers looking to integrate image manipulation in their applications using an API.
author: pilioai

sections.overview:
GPT Image 2 is a Pilio skill that enables developers to generate and edit images programmatically using text prompts or image references. The skill integrates with the Pilio CLI and delegates image generation tasks to the Pilio developer API, allowing seamless image manipulation workflows within agent applications. It supports both image generation from text and editing existing images, making it suitable for content creation, design automation, and dynamic asset generation. Developers can test the functionality in a browser at pilio.ai before deploying it to agents, and full documentation is available through the Pilio developer portal.
Generate images from textual prompts
Edit images based on reference images
Compose images using local inputs
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/pilioai/skills --skill gpt-image-2`
`git clone https://github.com/pilioai/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Generate an image using GPT Image 2 via the Pilio CLI. Use the prompt: '[DESCRIBE_IMAGE_NEEDED]' and apply these parameters: --style [ART_STYLE], --resolution [WIDTHxHEIGHT], --quality [QUALITY_LEVEL]. Output the image as a PNG file named '[FILENAME].png'.
```
Copy

```
```
Generated image saved as `product_hero_v2.png`:

![Product Hero Image](https://example.com/images/product_hero_v2.png)

**Details:**
- **Style:** Cyberpunk neon
- **Resolution:** 1920x1080
- **Quality:** High (100%)
- **Prompt Used:** "A futuristic cyberpunk product hero shot with glowing blue accents, sleek metallic surface, and dark background, ultra-detailed"

**Usage:**
- File saved in `/output/images/` directory.
- Ready for integration into [COMPANY]’s marketing campaign.
```
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
